'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Mike Kiesling LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kiesling]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike Kessling
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
